changes.rules:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may tap an untapped creature you control with power 4 or greater. If you do, put a charge counter on The Wrath of Achilles.
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, if there are one or more charge counters on The Wrath of Achilles, remove all of them. When you do, at the beginning of combat on your next turn, untap each creature you control. Until end of turn, creatures you control with power 4 or greater get +X/+0 and gain trample, where X is the number of charge counters removed this way.
